hints.title: History Dependencies
hints.text: The next roll value depends on the previous roll (must be coprime and distinct) and the roll before that (must be distinct).

hints.title: State Formulation
hints.text: Maintain dp[prev][prev_prev] storing the number of valid sequences of current length ending with (prev, prev_prev).

hints.title: Coprime Transition Table
hints.text: Precompute valid transitions where gcd(curr, prev) is 1, curr differs from prev, and curr differs from prev_prev, modulo 10^9 + 7.

hints.title: Die Roll History State DP Implementation

complexity.notes: State transitions evaluate 6^3 = 216 states per step.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate observes that only the last two dice rolls constrain the next choice.
